description.value: A lakeside wilderness lodge campground on Tyaughton Lake in the Southern Chilcotin Range, sharing grounds with a spa, gourmet restaurant, and heliskiing operation — a social, resort atmosphere far from any town. The long approach via Lillooet and Gold Bridge includes an 8 km gravel stretch on Tyaughton Lake Road.

address.value: 1 Tyaughton Lake Rd, Gold Bridge, BC V0K 1P0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a campground exists as a listed lodging option ('Enjoy a variety of accommodations - from our large log lodge and private chalets to our scenic campground'), and mountain biking is a primary advertised activity. Phone numbers appear only on the website (not in OSM tags), and the OSM name 'Tyax Wilderness Resort and Spa' differs from the website's primary branding of 'Tyax Lodge' and 'Tyax Lodge & Heliskiing.' The website notes 'The Lodge Re-Opens on May 29' against a current date of May 25, 2026, indicating seasonal operation, though chalets are stated as available now and the business is clearly active.
concerns: OSM name 'Tyax Wilderness Resort and Spa' differs from the website's primary branding of 'Tyax Lodge' and 'Tyax Lodge & Heliskiing' — the OSM name may be outdated.
No address in OSM tags; website provides only narrative driving directions, not a formal street address.
No phone number in OSM; both numbers (toll-free 1.877.918.8929 and international +1.250.238.2221) sourced from website only.
Website indicates 'The Lodge Re-Opens on May 29' as of May 25, 2026, confirming seasonal operation; campground-specific open dates are not stated.
Campground details (number of sites, hook-ups, specific facilities) are not described on the website — listed only as a lodging category without further elaboration.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate campground in a remote BC wilderness area with mountain biking and on-site dining; a genuinely useful destination listing for touring cyclists exploring the Chilcotin region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Mountain biking is explicitly listed as a primary lodge activity, and a blog post covers floatplane mountain biking in the Chilcotins. The remote access road (8 km off the Gold Bridge turn-off) means this is a planned destination for cyclists, not a casual overnight stop.
